items.question: Can people sign a waiver when they book?
items.answer: Yes. Add a waiver form to the event: the terms, an acknowledgement and a signature, kept as a receipt.

items.question: Who can see emergency details?
items.answer: You and the leads you give access to for that event. Nobody else.

items.question: Does {{brand.name}} track people on the trail?
items.answer: No. Leads mark who’s with them at each regroup and at the end. {{brand.name}} shows you anyone not marked.

items.question: Can leads use their own phones?
items.answer: Yes. Give each lead access for the event; it ends when the event does.

items.question: Does {{brand.name}} book transport?
items.answer: No. Add pick-up points and times to the event, and they’re on every booking.

items.question: Do people need an app?
items.answer: No. They book, sign and check in in their phone’s browser.
